endorsements.quote: Similar to how the advent of diagnostic imaging required the physician to understand, interpret, and explain the relevant results to patients, physicians of the future should be able to explain to patients the benefits and limitations of management plans guided by artificial intelligence.

unlisted_practices: Integrate data science and AI as a core competency into undergraduate medical curricula.
Introduce data science through an early anchor course paired with longitudinal integration across the medical curriculum.
Continuously review and update data science curricula to accommodate new developments.
Appoint an educational champion to oversee and update data science educational materials across the curriculum.
Provide faculty development for medical educators who teach data science and AI content.
Teach medical students an approach to evaluate novel data sources for appropriateness before integrating them into clinical decision-making.
Teach medical students to assess clinical decision support tools for data quality, inherent biases, generalizability, data shift, and accuracy.

screen.reason: This is a perspective/commentary article outlining recommendations and frameworks for incorporating data science and AI competencies into undergraduate medical education curricula.
